{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Reload data to ensure clean state
data = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float, coercing errors to NaN
data['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(data['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for LOYAL customers
loyal_customers = data[data['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the conversion rate: number of converted LOYAL customers / total LOYAL customers
num_converted = loyal_customers['converted'].sum()
total_loyal = len(loyal_customers)
conversion_fraction = num_converted / total_loyal

# Print the result
conversion_fraction"}
